trace: ConceptionQuantumState publicly exposes an 8-bit conserved_joint_minutes and a 64-bit next_trial_ordinal. The planner uses a 60-minute quantum and reduces the supplied remainder modulo 60 before calculating crossings. A representable constructed remainder of 60 with zero additional minutes is therefore normalized to zero and produces no trial; whether such a value can be legitimately or corruptly admitted through current storage remains open.

The planner constructs trial ordinals and the next ordinal with saturating addition. If constructed at u64::MAX with at least two crossings, distinct returned trial positions receive the same ordinal. The strategic reducer forms receipt identity and random entropy from that ordinal and consults a receipt before insert; no claim is made that an ordinary chronologically bounded game can reach this state, or that database transaction behavior was observed.

The inspected reducer defaults a missing accrual to zero, passes stored fields into the planner, then writes the resulting remainder and ordinal back. The strategic simulation runner also consumes the planner; these bounded paths do not prove all table writers, admissions, temporal limits, data integrity, or historical queue aliases. PregnancyOrdinal is a separate count and must not be conflated with trial ordinal.
